opportunities.name: United flight search by route and dates
opportunities.description: On united.com, search flights from {origin} to {destination} for {dates}, with optional {passengers}, {cabin}, trip type or miles, then open a fare.
steps: Open the United booking form
Type the departure city and pick the matching airport
Type the destination city and pick the matching airport
Open the Depart date picker and choose the departure and return dates (move between months if needed)
Optionally change passengers, cabin class, one-way or book-with-miles
Click Find flights
Optionally select a fare or open its details or seats

instances.values: Pune (PNQ) -> New York (NYC), selected $2,984 economy roundtrip
Springfield (SPI) -> Austin (AUS), one-way Apr 29 2023, viewed details/seats
Santa Fe (SAF) -> Phoenix (PHX), 13th-28th of next month, selected $681 economy

opportunities.name: TripAdvisor restaurant search with a filter
opportunities.description: On TripAdvisor, search restaurants in {location} and apply a {cuisine/feature filter}.
steps: Click Restaurants
Type the location into the search box
Pick the matching location suggestion
Optionally open 'More restaurants' or click 'Show more' in the filters
Check the filter you want (cuisine, dietary or feature)
Click Apply if asked

opportunities.name: SpotHero event parking search
opportunities.description: On SpotHero, find parking near {venue} for {event}, with optional filters, sort order and time window.
steps: Type the venue into 'Search for parking'
Pick the matching venue suggestion
Optionally pick the event date
Click the event you want
Optionally click Filter, check amenities (e.g. Wheelchair Accessible), then show the results
Optionally set the sort order
Optionally set Start and End Time and click Update Search
Optionally click Book Now

instances.values: Barclays Center, Magic at Nets, sort by distance, 3-5 PM, Book Now
Busch Stadium, Pirates at Cardinals, Wheelchair Accessible, sort by price
Barclays Center, Apr 9 2023, 76ers at Nets, Wheelchair Accessible, start 10 AM

opportunities.name: United map search from an origin
opportunities.description: On United, use the map/explore search to look at destinations from {origin}, with an optional trip type and flexible dates.
steps: Open BOOK and then Map search
Type the departure city into 'Flying from' and pick the airport
Optionally set the search type (e.g. Roundtrip) and Flexible dates
Click Search
Optionally open a result from the list
